Design and implement workflows around the realities of private practice — from due diligence, contract review and drafting to litigation, regulatory advisory, transactions and knowledge management. Partner with law firm partners, innovation leaders, knowledge teams and practising lawyers to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to outcomes that matter to the firm and its clients. Be the voice of the private practice lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial realities of law firms into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction. Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from associates and partners to firm leadership. Help firms navigate one of the most significant shifts in legal service delivery — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal work is performed, priced and delivered to clients. Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora partners with leading law firms as we grow globally. What you'll bring You've worked in private practice and understand the reality of delivering legal advice in a law firm. You know that great legal work isn't just about getting the right answer — it's about delivering exceptional quality under pressure, managing demanding clients, exercising sound judgement and balancing commercial expectations with the highest professional standards. But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how law firms operate and deliver value to their clients. We're looking for Meaningful experience working within a law firm, giving you a strong understanding of private practice, legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial pressures of delivering legal services. Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed. Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation. Commercially minded — you understand how law firms operate and can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to partners, practice groups and their clients. A natural translator — comfortable moving between practising lawyers, partners, innovation and knowledge teams, product teams and engineers. Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change. Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace. High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time. description: <p><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><em>Essential:</em></p> <ul> <li>You’ve designed and delivered large-scale GPU or HPC clusters into live data centres, and you were on site for the build</li> <li>Deep, practical knowledge of NVIDIA platforms (GB200/GB300 rack-scale and HGX H200/B200) and what each one demands of a facility</li> <li>Cluster-scale InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric design: topology, rail optimisation, oversubscription, and cable and optic selection</li> <li>Physical infrastructure design across power and redundancy, direct liquid cooling and CDUs, containment and achievable cable lengths</li> <li>You know part numbers, what’s optional and what isn’t, and you can hold an OEM to account when their commitments slip</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to Have:</em></p> <ul> <li>Factory integration and FAT experience, including holding a dispatch gate</li> <li>Storage design for AI workloads (WEKA, VAST, DDN, Ceph or similar)</li> <li>Deployments across multiple geographies and data centre operators, including sites requiring fit-out</li> <li>Neocloud or hyperscale experience on compressed schedules</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)</li> <li>Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment</li> <li>Visible, meaningful impact as we scale</li> <li>Clear career progression in a high-growth company</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. title: Senior FX Sales Executive
description: About the role Are you passionate about opening doors, winning new business, and building relationships with leading financial institutions? As a Senior FX Sales Executive , you'll play a key role in expanding DIGITEC's presence, with a strong focus on acquiring new clients and developing strategic business opportunities within the FX market. We're looking for a proactive, commercially driven sales professional who thrives on identifying opportunities, building a pipeline from the ground up, and turning prospects into long-term clients. You'll take ownership of the full sales cycle, from prospecting and initial engagement to commercial negotiations and closing deals. Working closely with our global Sales, Product, and Client Services teams, you'll introduce DIGITEC's innovative FX solutions to banks and financial institutions. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys the challenge of winning new business, values autonomy, and wants to make a direct impact on our international growth. The position is based in our London office, with hybrid working (2 days a week in the office). Your Responsibilities Identify, develop, and win new business opportunities with banks and financial institutions, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition . Build and manage a robust sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, networking, and strategic outreach. Own the full sales cycle , from initial contact and discovery meetings to product demonstrations, negotiations, and contract signing. Establish relationships with senior decision-makers across FX Trading, Treasury, Technology, and other relevant business areas. Identify market opportunities and develop effective strategies to expand DIGITEC's presence. Deliver compelling product presentations and demonstrations, translating complex FX technology into clear business value. Collaborate closely with global Sales, Product, and Client Services teams to develop tailored solutions and ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation. Represent DIGITEC at client meetings, industry conferences, and networking events to strengthen our visibility within the FX community. Provide market insights , competitive intelligence, and client feedback to support our commercial and product strategies. Travel internationally as needed to meet prospective clients, attend industry events, and collaborate with international colleagues. Preferred qualifications Several years of experience in B2B sales, new business development, or enterprise software sales , ideally within financial services or financial technology. A proven track record of acquiring new clients and closing new business , rather than primarily managing existing accounts. Experience within FX, Capital Markets, FICC, Treasury, electronic trading, fintech, or financial software. Strong understanding of financial markets and key stakeholders. Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers. Demonstrated ability to independently build and develop a sales pipeline, from prospect identification through deal closure. A proactive, entrepreneurial, and results-driven mindset, with a strong motivation to open new doors and win business. Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with confidence in engaging senior stakeholders. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with international teams. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage: An established professional network within banks, financial institutions, or the FX trading community. FX Swaps, NDFs, Money Markets, or electronic trading. FX trading platforms, order management systems, or banking technology. Enterprise SaaS or complex financial software sales. CRM systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies. Be part of an international workforce: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore. Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave. title: Senior Consultant, Tracking Strategy & Insights
description: Introduction: As a Senior Consultant on our newly formed Tracking Strategy & Insights (TS&I) team, you will act as the key strategic partner accountable for the successful integration and value realization of our clients’ tracking programs. You will blend deep marketing research expertise (informed by the Ehrenberg-Bass Institute school of thought) with exceptional storytelling skills to convert tracking technology insights into actionable business strategy. Are you curious and want to shoot for the stars, open to giving and receiving feedback, hungry for empowerment and always taking a hands-on approach? Well then we want to chat. quantilope automates consumer research to unlock high quality insights with speed & ease. We're a fast growing organization looking for the right people to join our team. What you will be doing: Strategic Program Management: Serve as the trusted advisor and lead partner for complex, multi-category, or multi-country tracking programs, maintaining continuous, high-level engagement with key client stakeholders and executives. Research Scoping: Lead discovery sessions to understand and define program needs, scope, objectives, and hypotheses. Translate core objectives into research inputs aligned with quantilope's methodology, setting customers up for long-term success. Workshop Moderation: Delight customers through expert-led Inspiration Workshops to refine pre-study inputs (e.g., category entry points) and Premium Activation Workshops to translate research findings directly into actionable strategic outcomes. Change Management: Drive client "buy-in" and organizational change, ensuring the adoption of new, market-leading metrics (e.g., EBI principles) and the successful integration of tracking insights into company strategy. Insights Delivery Excellence & Action: Ensure program deliverables yield excellent, action-generating insights aligned with client business objectives. Provide guidance on activating insights to influence overall brand planning. Client Growth & Commercial Success: Proactively identify upsell opportunities, collaborate early on pre-sales efforts and proofs of concept, and deliver sophisticated, data-driven presentations to executive audiences. Tracking Innovation & Scaling: Serve as a beta tester and subject matter expert for the Product team, collaborate to scale the tracking business through product, AI, or partner initiatives, and support Go-To-Market teams. Who you are: You have 5+ years of Brand Health Tracking experience, either working as a client-side researcher, at a market research agency or technology platform. You have an expert understanding of quantitative market research methodologies, particularly continuous brand health and advertising effectiveness measurement. You have demonstrable knowledge of modern marketing science principles (e.g., Ehrenberg-Bass Institute's "How Brands Grow" system) and ability to articulate their commercial value. You have proven ability to build trusted partnerships with senior executive stakeholders, lead workshops, and confidently present and persuade executive-level audiences. You have exceptional analytical capabilities with the ability to synthesize complex, multi-wave data into meaningful, strategic insights and compelling narratives. Benefits of working at quantilope: Wellness is key: We offer private health insurance with Vitality, a cash back plan, travel insurance for all your trips as well as regular mental health training, and the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have our quantiwell days which are global mental health days once a quarter where the whole company takes a day for themselves. Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year? Planning for the future: At quantilope, we keep your financial wellness top of mind with Nest Pension Plan. Team Bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties, global retreats..where in the world will we bring the team together next? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way. Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel. title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p>Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. The Roku TV organization builds technology used on millions of TVs globally, and the team is already applying AI to demanding TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.<br>As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer of roughl7 2-5yrs experience to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.<br>You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.<br><br></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> <br><strong><span data-contrast="none">We value </span></strong><span data-contrast="none">your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</span><strong><span data-contrast="none"> </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <h3><strong> </strong></h3> <h3><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.</li> <li>Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.</li> <li>Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.</li> <li>Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.</li> <li>Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.</li> <li>Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.</li> <li>Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.</li> <li>Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.</li> <li>Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.</li> <li>Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku?</strong> </h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.</li> <li>2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.</li> <li>Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.</li> <li>Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.</li> <li>Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li> <li>Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h6>#LI-NM1</h6> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. hybrid or remote position – our London team works together from the office five days a week.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Manage and retain sponsors:</strong> Build client base.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Own your revenue targets:</strong> Take responsibility for achieving ambitious individual sales and retention targets.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Deliver exceptional partnerships:</strong> Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure sponsors receive a high-quality experience and see value in their partnerships.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>What progression as we continue to grow.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>About us</h3> <p>United Media is building a global B2B media and conferences group, bringing together executives, investors, founders and industry leaders through conferences, communities and media brands. description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS). You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners. What you’ll do: Own the CASS oversight framework: Maintain and continuously improve Upvest's CASS risk assessment, controls matrix, policies and procedures across CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, providing clear guidance to the business on what is and isn't permitted. Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way. Oversee reconciliations and client money calculations: Oversee daily client money calculations and internal and external reconciliations of client money and custody assets, ensuring breaks are investigated promptly, shortfalls are funded and root causes are addressed. Manage breaches and regulatory reporting: Maintain the CASS breach register, assess materiality, drive remediation and support FCA notifications where required. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion. Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change. Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design. Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest. Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights. What you bring: Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates. Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits. Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls. Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks. Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines. It’s great if you have: Qualifications: Relevant industry certifications such as CISI Client Assets Specialist qualification, an accounting or audit background, or equivalent professional certification in a related discipline. How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest. Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it. Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose. Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies. Our Values: Make it easy for others. title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time. The Role We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it. This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you. What You'll Work On The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona. The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this. The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one. The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work. Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one. You'll Probably Have Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready. Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy. Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them. Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them. Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server. Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team. An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too. Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same. How We Work We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish. There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point. Compensation: £95K – £120K • Offers Equity • £95K – £120K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link. Bring-Up & Debug: Lead firmware bring-up on new boards and sensors, debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and in-system probes. Source Control & Build: Keep RTL under version control with a repeatable, automated build, and document designs to the standard our ISO 9001 design control process requires. Reviews & Support: Contribute to design reviews, and support the software team and customers during field integration. Experience & Skills: Essential: Strong proficiency in Verilog, and a solid grounding in RTL design, synthesis and timing closure. Hands-on experience with AMD-Xilinx Vivado and its toolchain. Experience writing your own testbenches and verifying a design in simulation before hardware. Experience bringing up firmware on real hardware and debugging it in the lab. Experience with at least one high-speed interface or bus at RTL level. Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in. Working with complex, existing codebases and seamlessly integrating new functionality with minimal disruption. Desirable: SystemVerilog, and verification practices beyond directed testbenches. Comfortable working in Linux operating systems. Exposure to any of PCIe, AXI interface, USB3, Ethernet, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS or Camera Link. C, C++ or Python for embedded software integration and test automation. Experience with image sensors, time-of-flight, TDCs or single-photon detection. Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, and reading schematics during debug. Educational Background: Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2-5 years' experience in FPGA and digital design. Key Attributes & Behaviours: Rigour: Disciplined about verification - you would rather find it in simulation than on the bench. Debugging: Systematic when the fault could be in the RTL, the board or the sensor, and comfortable with the instruments that tell you which. Clarity: Writes documentation and code that colleagues can pick up without you in the room. Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA. Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through. Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move. Success Indicators: Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench. Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly. Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work. Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics At Singular Photonics, we are committed to fostering a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. As an FPGA Firmware Engineer, you will benefit from: Pension: 5% company contribution. Share Options: Participation in the Company EMI Share Option Scheme, so you share in the growth you help build. Enhanced Annual Leave: 35 days paid annual leave per year, inclusive of UK public holidays. Hybrid Working: Primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week (full time worker). Career Growth: Work on silicon and systems few engineers get near, with the chance to shape how we do FPGA development as the team grows. Additional Benefits: [Cycle to work and private medical insurance (once implemented) Why Join Us This position offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of SPAD sensor technology, driving innovation and shaping future applications in photonics and imaging. At Singular Photonics you will be part of a passionate, close-knit team, where the work you do is visible in the product and in the hands of customers. Location & Work Environment Based at Orchard Brae House, Queensferry Road, Edinburgh. This is a full-time, permanent role. The work is hands-on with hardware in our lab, so it is primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week. Right to work in the UK is essential. We are unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Equal Opportunities Singular Photonics is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make appointments on merit, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process, please let us know and we will do what we can to accommodate you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.</strong></p> <p>Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.</p> <p>With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.</p> <p><strong>The job</strong></p></div><h1><strong>Principal Infrastructure Engineer</strong></h1> <p>More than 80 million women open Flo every month to understand their bodies and their health. We treat our internal developers as our customers. Coding experience in Go or Python is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> A doc-first habit, and the ability to bring distributed product teams with you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI first: you will have seen the impact AI automation is having on development teams and the software delivery lifecycle, and have strong ideas on how infrastructure should support it.</strong></p> <h2><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hardening infrastructure for high-compliance or security-sensitive environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI).</li> <li>Running managed data services in AWS (RDS, Aurora, MSK, DynamoDB) at scale, including migrations and major version upgrades.</li> <li>Scaling consumer platforms with millions of concurrent users.</li> <li>Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, CKA or CKS.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Join Flo?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>High impact:</strong> Flo is used by 1 in 4 women aged 18–44 in the US, and has raised $200M to build what comes next.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> We hire experts and trust them to deliver.</li> <li><strong>Modern stack at scale:</strong> EKS, Terraform, Kafka, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Sentry, serving more than 80 million people a month.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Annual Salary Range (ranges may vary based on skills and experience)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£130,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£150,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.</p> <h4>About Kaluza</h4> <p>Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.</p> <p>With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.</p> <h4>What you’ll do</h4> <p>Hands-on research</p> <ul> <li>Run mixed-methods research in a B2B2C setting, combining qualitative studies with behavioural data in Mixpanel, that sets the standard for good research and shapes team roadmaps and client conversations</li> <li>Research the whole chain, from client teams and subject matter experts to their end customers and the developers using our SDKs and APIs, and look for patterns that hold across clients so we build once and reuse</li> <li>Make sure research has impact: track whether it changed a decision and what result followed, and use that to make the case for research investment</li> </ul> <p>Research enablement and operations</p> <ul> <li>Democratise research: coach and mentor colleagues in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own studies with rigour, through workshops, guidance and lightweight methods</li> <li>Make insight easy to find and trust, through our insights agents, knowledge bases and journey management artefacts, backed by data you can rely on (quality, privacy, bias), so people can find and question evidence themselves</li> <li>Help run research operations: improve how we recruit participants (frameworks, lead times, consent and data protection), and set clear guardrails so teams run ethical, compliant research</li> <li>Assess and recommend research tools, deciding when to build and when to buy, trial them, and support procurement; use AI-assisted development such as Claude Code to build working tools where that is the right call</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring <br></strong><br>Ideally you’ll have/be</p> <ul> <li>A track record of running research end to end that other teams used in product or roadmap decisions, with strong data literacy: you combine qualitative methods with behavioural data and know what the numbers can and can’t tell us</li> <li>Experience researching in B2B or B2B2C or enterprise contexts, including technical users such as developers (eg SDKs, APIs or documentation), or a strong appetite to learn how</li> <li>Experience coaching non-researchers in research fundamentals (interviewing, bias mitigation, ethical handling of user data) so they can self-serve</li> <li>Experience on a platform or multi-client product, spotting patterns across customers, and familiarity with journey mapping or service design methods</li> <li>Experience in research operations or enablement, such as participant recruitment, consent and data governance, repositories or tool selection, with judgement on when to build and when to buy</li> <li>Confidence working with some autonomy across a distributed, international team</li> </ul> <p><strong>What will set you apart</strong> </p> <ul> <li>You’ve built a tool, repository or pipeline that measurably cut the time from research signal to team-wide insight</li> <li>You’ve found a way to measure developer experience where there was no playbook (eg time to first successful call, or where developers drop off)</li> <li>You’ve made the case for research with real numbers, and followed your research after the readout to see what happened</li> </ul> <p><strong>Where you'll work<br></strong>We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. title: Senior Infrastructure Manager
description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader. In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed. The Team You Will Lead You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms. You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in: On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments. Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused. Cloud environments: GCP and AWS Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD) The Operational Reality It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources. Context Switching is the Norm You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve. Agility over Silos Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum. Focus Management Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time. As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will: People Leadership & Talent Development Team Management Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management. Formal Training & Growth Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports. Recruitment & Retention Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture. Culture of Learning Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference. Strategic & Operational Management Budget & Capacity Planning Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware. Risk & Contingency Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity. Procedure & Frameworks Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards. Prioritisation Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations. Technical Support & Oversight Performance Optimisation Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them. Visual Documentation Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor. Hybrid Estate Management Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments. Unblocking Issues Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover. General Duties On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations. Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Leadership & Management Competencies Proven Management Experience Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc). Project Management Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment. Communication Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members. Goal Oriented You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met. ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts. Technical Environment & Team Capabilities Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions. For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration. Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey. Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation. Innovation & Debt Management A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt. Advanced Containerization Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems. Observability Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana). Data Streaming Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid. Web & Storage Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster. Tooling Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Version Control strong understanding of Git and version control best practices. Why This Role? If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role. UK Benefits & Perks 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year Private Medical Insurance through Vitality Enhanced pension contributions Cycle to Work scheme Eye Care Vouchers Life Assurance Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program Regular company events and activities Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception. Privacy and data protection . The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/ Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. About the role Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up. You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them. You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build. What you’ll be doing Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production. Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it. Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight. Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control. Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship. Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it. Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you. What you’ll need to have done Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language. Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years. Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end. A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket. Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each. Genuine appetite for problems with no known answer, and comfort working without a precedent to copy. Confident, responsible use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output. Receptiveness to feedback. We give it directly and often, and we expect you to give it back. Helpful, not required Experience in insurance, underwriting, or another complex regulated domain. We will teach you the domain. We cannot teach curiosity about it. Experience across both backend and frontend. Experience building workflow, decision-support, or agent-assisted products. Experience working directly with enterprise clients. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this. Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Warehouse Solution Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design end-to-end warehouse and fulfilment solutions for complex enterprise customers, from initial concept through to detailed proposals.</li> <li>Develop warehouse layouts, storage strategies, material flows, picking methodologies and operational processes.</li> <li>Evaluate and incorporate automation technologies, including AutoStore, Libiao and Geek+ robotics, based on customer requirements.</li> <li>Assess capacity, throughput, labour requirements and operational constraints to ensure solutions <li>Translate customer needs into clear technical specifications and tailored fulfilment solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Modelling & Commercial Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop capacity plans, throughput models and operational resource requirements using customer data.</li> <li>Support solution simulations, cost modelling and ROI analysis to demonstrate the benefits of proposed solutions.</li> <li>Work with commercial teams to ensure designs are technically feasible, cost-effective and commercially viable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Proposals & Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Produce technical solution proposals incorporating warehouse layouts, process flows, automation configurations and supporting financial analysis.</li> <li>Present solutions to customer stakeholders and support tenders, RFPs and complex sales processes.</li> <li>Collaborate with operations, engineering, software and implementation teams to validate designs and ensure successful delivery.</li> <li>Define integration requirements across THG Fulfil’s WMS/WCS/OMS platforms and automated warehouse equipment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experience Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in warehouse solutions design, logistics engineering, intralogistics, automation engineering or supply chain solutions.</li> <li>Experience designing warehouse or fulfilment solutions for large-scale or complex operations.</li> <li>Strong understanding of warehouse processes, including storage, replenishment, picking, packing, sortation and dispatch.</li> <li>Knowledge of warehouse automation, including robotics, automated storage and retrieval systems, conveyors or goods-to-person solutions.</li> <li>Experience with warehouse layouts, capacity planning, throughput modelling and operational analysis.</li> <li>Commercial awareness, including experience supporting cost models, ROI calculations and customer proposals.</li> <li>Understanding of WMS, WCS and OMS platforms and their integration with warehouse automation.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions clearly to technical and commercial stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable:</strong> Experience within 3PL, contract logistics or e-commerce fulfilment, with exposure to AutoStore, Libiao, Geek+ or warehouse design and simulation tools.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. description: <p><strong>About Us:</strong>  </p> <p>We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.</p> <p><strong>This position is located in London, England. </strong>Our office is situated in a core location near Waterloo and Blackfriars on the Southbank. Across the globe, our Centers of Energy serve as hubs where we accelerate productivity and collaboration, inspire creativity, and cultivate a culture of connection and celebration. Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.</p> <p>To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our <a href="https://www.logicmonitor.com/careers">Careers Page</a>.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.</p> <p>Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row! </p> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <p>In the professional services team, our mission is to be the trusted partner to the technical teams and strategic partner to the CIO. We empower teams to optimize performance, enhance client satisfaction, and achieve an unparalleled view of their infrastructure thus allowing the nirvana of being proactive and resolving incidents before they become problems. We help enable insights into not only the infrastructure but also the business and its key value metrics.</p> <p>The Associate Solutions Architect (A.SA) supports the Professional Services (PS) organization in assisting customers to implement the LM Envision platform, extend its capabilities through custom work,  and help drive their business goals by providing a best-in-class service. The A.SA is responsible for working with pre-sales and post-sales teams to scope, design and deploy technical solutions and implementations for LogicMonitor's customers. The A.SA is a product expert that creatively solves business observability problems with LogicMonitor's LM Envision platform.</p> </div> <p><strong>Here's a closer look at this key ITIL</p> </li> <li> <p>1+ years experience in one or more programming language: Python, PowerShell, Java or Groovy</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with HTTP, JSON, RegEx, REST APIs, OIDs and MIB title: Director of Product Design
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers. Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars. We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses. That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve. WHAT YOU'LL DO Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years. Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger. Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience. Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it. Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers. Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems. Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better. Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself. You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple. You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both. You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better. Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference. We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real. Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most. The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers. Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without.
