title: Product Manager
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual. For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less. This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Product Strategy & Execution: Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity Partner Engagement & Insight: Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions Cross-functional Leadership: Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you NICE TO HAVE Experience in automotive, marketplace, or dealer-facing products Familiarity with gamification or engagement loop design in a B2B context Background in scale-up or high-growth environments Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch INTERVIEW PROCESS Step 1: Talent Screening Call (30 min) Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min) Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task) Step 4: Values Interview (45 min) WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! title: VP of Marketing
description: Get to know us Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours. Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR) : Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions. Ideals Board : Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making. The role Ideals is uniquely positioned to redefine the VDR industry. Now we aim to own the upmarket M&A segment and establish Ideals as the Tier 1 brand in that space - translating market leadership into stronger brand equity, pipeline, and revenue. We're looking for a VP of Marketing to make this happen. You'll lead a high-performing global team and shape the marketing function end-to-end: positioning and category authority, a scalable demand engine, and the operating system behind it. This is a builder's role for a strategic, data-driven leader who wants their work to show up in commercial results, not just in brand tracking. This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the UK , Ireland, Switzerland, or the Netherlands. What you will do Define how Ideals wins You'll own positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and GTM plans across every product, segment, and region – the strategic foundation everything else in marketing builds on. Build category authority From industry events, reports, and benchmarks to media relations, executive visibility, and speaking programmes - you'll make Ideals the name the upmarket M&A segment thinks of first, and keep every external touchpoint aligned with our brand positioning. Turn attention into pipeline You'll drive demand generation across paid and organic channels, ABM, content, and nurture, then guide the team capturing it through search, review platforms, intent data, and conversion optimisation. As the Key Accounts Sales team scales, you'll direct regional programmes into each market's sales plan and own the result end to end against pipeline and revenue targets. Run marketing as a system You'll own the martech and analytics stack, attribution, KPI framework, and ROI reporting – plus the marketing budget, agencies, and strategic vendors – so every decision is data-driven, and every dollar is accountable. Lead the people who make it happen You'll hire, develop, and lead a global team, and work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to drive cohesive business growth. What you bring 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong SaaS background 4+ years in a senior marketing leadership role within a fast-growing company, with responsibility for the broader marketing function Proven experience leading and scaling diverse high-performing marketing teams, including hiring, talent development, and performance management Brand marketing portfolio with proven activation expertise across diverse channels and markets Hands-on experience across content, design, and growth initiatives, with the ability to go deep when needed Track record scaling digital and field marketing programs that measurably grew pipeline and revenue Solid understanding of demand generation and ABM initiatives Successful track record of implementing marketing initiatives based on analytical and data-driven decisions Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with a can-do attitude Fluency in English (C1+ level) Nice to have Experience in M&A, Investment Banking, or Financial Services, with a strong understanding of the dealmaking ecosystem What we offer We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential. title: Account Executive – Sales Talent Pool: Register Your Interest
description: We're always keen to hear from talented sales professionals. This is not a current vacancy, but if you'd like to be considered for future opportunities at Bitwarden, register your interest and we'll contact you if a suitable role opens. Our password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey solutions make it easy for everyone to extend robust security across their devices. Bitwarden is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, with a team located across the globe. What our Account Executives do Own a territory and an assigned quota, closing new business with a focus on organisations of 1,000+ employees Prospect effectively and manage lead flow to build a strong pipeline (typically 3–5x coverage) Manage and forecast the pipeline accurately in our CRM Build territory plans that deliver both short-term and long-term revenue Recruit, onboard and grow channel partners, including resellers, MSPs, VARs and integrators, and build joint business plans with measurable goals Work closely with marketing on events, programmes and campaigns that create demand among partners' customers Keep sales leadership informed on channel pipeline and forecast Who we'd love to hear from 4–8 years of SaaS sales experience in new business or business development. Cyber security experience is a plus but not essential A consistent track record of hitting annual quota, with specific customer wins you can talk about Proven success driving revenue through partners, with strong existing relationships with resellers, MSPs, VARs or integrators The ability to build relationships and influence decision makers at every level of a partner or customer organisation Experience at a startup or high-growth company is desirable A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and can work independently or as part of a team Excellent communication skills: listening, writing and presenting Confident with CRM tools, Google Workspace and Microsoft Office A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience Additional languages are welcome, as some territories may require them What happens next Submit your CV along with a short note telling us where you're based and the type of territory or role you're interested in. If a suitable Account Executive role opens, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you. Our process typically includes a screening call, interviews with sales leadership and the team, and a role play. A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world's largest organisations. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. </p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. </p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data & technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>

Our name is both our mission and our method. We do our best work for brave brands and people who relish being challenged to go further and faster, together.</p> <p>The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at Wavemaker. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.</p> <p> </p> <p>Wavemaker UK is looking for a <strong>Planning Director</strong> to join our growing planning team, to drive planning across specific clients and be a media planning expert.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Media planning craft:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop an advanced understanding of media channels, channel ecosystems and planning best practices.</li> <li>Start to translate strategic approach into planning practices for specific client briefs and pitches.</li> <li>Have an advanced understanding of Wavemakers’s Purchase Journey thinking and planning philosophy across all client work. Including being an expert in a broad set of internal tools, as well as external tools to build a deep understanding of the consumer, the client’s business and its specific opportunities.</li> <li>Have an expert overview of the media market landscape, trends and start to build media owner relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Campaign management & effective communication:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee campaign management, ensuring quality control and output is of the highest standard.</li> <li>Develop a skilled understand of commercial practises and of the wider agency.</li> <li>Build and maintain client and agency relationships at a mid-senior level, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of stakeholders and client business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Comms planning and storytelling: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own planning presentations including defining the inputs needed and working with the wider teams to compile work and meet deadlines.</li> <li>Lead brainstorm and idea creation for campaigns</li> <li>Start to independently problem solve, including integrating and questioning data and insights and find solutions based on knowledge and experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p> </p> <p> <strong>Practice Area Knowledge -Skilled-</strong> Develops breadth and depth of industry understanding. Becomes confident using tools, technology, techniques and systems and is able to train others.</p> <p>Comfortable presenting both direct from platform (OS, Architect etc) and developing a story from data but delivered outside of platform (Telmar etc).</p> <p>Can confidently answer client questions and liaise with internal teams on best solutions to use.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Problem Solving – Skilled</strong> - Uses critical questioning and maintains a broad perspective when analyzing information to gain a deeper understanding of the problem and wider impact. Quickly generates appropriate solutions informed by previous experience. Understands how to resolve escalated issues and supports others to problem solve. Supports or leads troubleshooting communication for issues.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Relationships – Skilled</strong> - Has an expert knowledge of client and agency structures. Can identify key decision makers and understands their perspectives which is used to build relationships. Has strong knowledge of the client sector/industry which is shared to build strategies and plans. Identifies strategic issues and raises questions to help stakeholders explore and understand their wider business challenges. ​​​​​​​ Can easily suggest business solutions to match client/stakeholder needs and achieve objectives.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Effective Communication -Advanced-</strong> Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Campaign Management – Advanced -</strong> Reviews the work of others to ensure accuracy and thoroughness objectives have been met; provides coaching on ways to improve work outputs.  Applies best practice to campaign management and acts as the escalation point for issues.  Provide actionable insights during mid and post campaign reports to improve in-flight optimizations and future campaign brief recommendations.  Oversees team members to discuss current projects, workload and activities prioritises resources accordingly.  Improves workload management by supporting other in setting priorities and by postponing less relevant work.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compelling Storytelling – Skilled -</strong> Applies big picture thinking in work and proactively leverages an understanding of the organization and key industry trends.  Understand the different elements of responses.  Designs differentiated communications (content focus, style, presentation etc) for various internal and external audiences.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ideas Creation – Advanced -</strong> Lead new projects/activities that can create ideas to deliver effective solutions to clients business objectives.  Ability to proactively generate ideas to provoke and deliver against broader business strategies.  Coaches other to gain new insights and view opportunities from different perspectives.  Championing an environment that fosters innovation by encouraging others to openly share and build on other’s new ideas, products and solutions</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Comms Planning – Skilled -</strong> Applies knowledge of client, audience, channel, market and category to effectively deliver compelling multi-media plans.  Translates learnings and trends to create marketing communication strategies that are effective with clear measurement.   Application of purchase journey thinking and visualization of how the media plan works channels.  Translation of strategic direction/platform/provocation into directional role for media, channel role and behaviour in channel.  Identifies and recommends budget shifts as campaign is in-flight where appropriate.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. title: Director, Partnerships, Global
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>11625 - Director, Partnerships, Global</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>This Partnerships Director role is the link between our Global Investment specialists and WPP Media and agency Client Account teams, working to define and deliver joint business plan (JBP) partnership opportunities for key global clients, primarily The Coca Cola Company but with the opportunity to expand to other brands such as Ford, Colgate and Estee Lauder.  This role will also work in tandem with Strategy leads and Account teams to identify relevant media partners, to then develop integrated investment strategies with, delivering best in class, progressive, strategic client partnerships.</p> <p>Aided by support from the broader team, the Partnerships Director will define client’s JBPs with media partners, such as Google, Amazon, Pinterest, Meta and TikTok, to maximise client benefits, and then work to deliver these commercial and strategic benefits, throughout the year.  Cooperation with, and co-ordination of, local and regional market teams will be central to this, to ensure a consistent approach and successful execution of the negotiated benefits.</p> <p>This role will require high levels of relationship management, strategy, coordination and organization as it will involve management of a complex client and agency structure.</p> <p><strong>The Partnerships Director </strong>will need to gain a deep understanding of our client’s businesses and will need to apply their digital (and to a lesser extent, offline) landscape and strategic knowledge to ensure that the client partnership team delivers the most effective plans to deliver on the client’s objectives and the changing entertainment marketing landscape.</p> <p>They will be responsible for managing partner relationships with the key digital vendors (Meta, Amazon, Google, etc.) to ensure that our clients gain maximum benefits from trading deals brokered and JBPs. Measurement is a key part of the role, so this role is also responsible for ensuring that digital investment associated with the JBPs is tracked and reported back to the client, to ensure full transparency of pacing versus any investment endeavours in place. </p> <p><strong>Reporting of the role</strong></p> <p>This role reports to the Global Head of Partnerships.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities of the role:</strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic Skills </strong></p> <ul> <li>Work collaboratively within the WPP Media network, and specialist practice departments e.g. DPAM teams, Brand Safety and Governance, , to deliver innovative and media-first, cross media Global JBP opportunities</li> <li>Develop a strong understanding of media landscape working closely with on and offline Global partners, to ensure first mover opportunities are leveraged for client</li> <li>Support in development and monitoring of opportunities with key vendors in the Diversity, Sustainability and Inclusion space, helping to grow client spend</li> <li>Identify key areas of partnership growth and work collaboratively with client teams, as an extension to their strategy & planning teams, to deliver and activate Global JBPs</li> <li>Support in the deployment and monitoring of Global JBPs, across local markets and regions, to ensure targets are met and value is unlocked</li> </ul> <p><strong>External Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate an ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, global media vendors, proprietary<strong> </strong>media opcos and internal teams, to drive collaboration and best in class delivery</li> <li>Develop and sell partnerships persuasively and with confidence, passion and enthusiasm to both clients and internal stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivery Excellence </strong></p> <ul> <li>Present confidently, with gravitas & impact</li> <li>Proactively share global marketplace updates and work with markets to do the same</li> </ul> <p><strong>New business </strong></p> <ul> <li>Support where needed in new business pitches and proposals, supporting client and strategy teams in content partnership proposals in group pitches</li> </ul> <p><strong>General tasks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a full understanding of in all areas of the WPP Media and agency Work is recognised by awards, agency-first’s and also TelCo-firsts for the EMEA market. This role will be part of an agency-team-wide-push to adopt AI and drive innovation to drive client outcomes.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The main focus area of this role are as below;</strong></p> <p><br><strong>Data-led audience and bidding strategy enablement;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Using the data-sets and technology available to BTEE, lead and oversee the delivery of test, trial and strategy recommendations across paid media campaigns on addressable channels.</li> <li>Working closely with the Transformation lead and ensuring broader strategic workstreams and acceleration projects find a place in campaign activity and are set up in a way that's measurable and methodical.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Technology Project Ownership;</strong></p> <ul> <li>As part of the BTEE’s Media Acceleration Roadmap, you will own broader workstreams to drive outcomes across DPAM use-cases, including the clients roadmap with Amazon Marketing Cloud.</li> <li>You will be part of wider workstreams that bring together the power of WPP as a group, which for example could include working with parts of the business beyond WPP Media, in order to bring new exciting projects to BT.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration;</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will be in charge of Open Connect’s paid media Audience Approach and Audience Playbook, ensuring this stays up to date. </li> <li>Maintaining and improving Data Strategy ways of working in the campaign cycle with other internal agency practices on the BT account.</li> <li>Be a conduit between technical and less technical teams within the agency, ensuring alignment on project goals and client objectives and speaking in the correct data language to the clients.</li> <li>Work with the client and embedded agency teams to define, justify and request future signals and data products which can drive the clients business goals. This includes our internal Tech & AI Consulting team and the embedded engineering team at BTEE who build data products for us.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>This role sits in the Operations Pod of the team, alongside a Data Strategy Associate Director, Data Strategy Manager and a Data Strategy Associate.</li> <li>Each team member will own the Data Strategy for a specific product vertical but you will lead this Pod. You will need to ensure they are producing high quality work and look to unblock any challenges they have.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Deep interest in Media & Technology: An understanding of and desire to learn more about data products, AI, technology, and trends within the advertising and marketing industry with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Customer Focus: A relentless focus on client success, with a passion for delivering exceptional client experiences and driving long-term relationships.</li> <li>Communication and Presentation Skills: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, as this role hinges on effective interaction with clients and agency partners.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple stakeholders in a matrixed environment</li> <li>6+ years digital agency-side working on a data-led role either agency, vendor or client side, with a strong emphasis on digital paid media.</li> <li>Highly developed interpersonal, team building and relationship management skills</li> <li>TelCo experience preferable but not required</li> <li>Understanding of the importance of privacy first media and what that means for how we need to do things differently</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. description: As a Revenue Operations Engineer at vCluster Labs, you aren't just keeping the CRM tidy; you are building the automated engine that tells our sellers which accounts matter and why. You will design Clay pipelines, enrichment workflows, and AI agents that surface the right accounts to sales and SDRs, and you will make sure they keep working long after launch. You own the GTM stack for our EMEA team, from Salesforce workflows to the integrations that tie HubSpot, Notion, and Slack together. As a Revenue Operations Engineer, your role will include: Account intelligence and enrichment: You will build and extend Clay tables, enrichment, and discovery pipelines that find new accounts and surface the right ones to sales and SDRs. You will push the tool well past its current setup and get the full value out of it. AI agents and automation: You will turn manual GTM workflows into automated ones using agents in Clay, Salesforce, and Claude. You build them to run end to end and stay useful, not to demo once and break a month later. Data quality that stays clean: You will design repeatable processes that keep account and contact data accurate over time. When a cleanup happens, it happens once, and the workflow behind it prevents the mess from coming back. Scoring and top-of-funnel signals: You will own account and MQL funnel scoring and the signal workflows that route intent to the right seller at the right time. Systems and integrations: You will build Salesforce workflows and maintain integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, Momentum, Chili Piper, Notion, and Slack. When a new tool or feature beats what we built six months ago, you will make the call to replace it. EMEA RevOps support: You will own the RevOps ticket queue during EMEA hours, partnering with our US-based RevOps teammate for follow-the-sun coverage. That includes helping reps with live opportunity questions, not only systems work. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: Hands-on Clay experience: You have built Clay tables, enrichment waterfalls, and pipelines yourself, and can explain what you would build next. Salesforce depth: You can build Salesforce flows and automation, not just run reports. HubSpot fluency is expected alongside it. AI-forward building: You have built AI agents or automations that run in production, using tools like Claude, Clay agents, or Salesforce automation, and you can show what they do today. Systems thinking for GTM: You understand how scoring, routing, enrichment, and CRM hygiene connect, and you design for the whole loop rather than one fix. EMEA-based and self-directed: You are based in EMEA, comfortable owning a queue without a teammate in your time zone, and you decide what to fix next without waiting to be told. Bonus points for: Salesforce Admin certification: Or equivalent admin-level experience owning an org. Code and CLI comfort: Experience with scripting, APIs, the Claude CLI, or MCP integrations. Startup scaling experience: You have helped a company grow from Series A toward later stage and built the systems that growth needed. Advanced Clay or Anthropic tooling: You are the person others ask when they want to know what Clay or Claude can actually do. About vCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. title: Talent Operations Associate - FTC
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About Talent Operations Talent Operations partners with Wayve’s hiring teams to deliver a thoughtful, well-organised experience for candidates, interviewers and hiring teams. In this London-based role, you’ll work closely with approximately six recruiters and take ownership of interview coordination across multiple regions. You’ll help keep hiring moving smoothly while building strong relationships across the London office and wider business. 🧠 Your day-to-day Coordinate interviews from request through to completion, managing schedules, changes and candidate communications. Prioritise a busy queue of requests, keeping records and handovers accurate and flagging capacity or blockers early. Provide warm, proactive support to candidates, recruiters, interviewers and hiring managers. Handle recruitment support requests and job-approval tasks promptly and accurately. Learn our systems and processes quickly, using documentation and colleagues to investigate issues and solve problems independently. Work with Talent Partners and teams across the business to resolve scheduling challenges and improve how we work. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Supporting around 90–100 individual interviews each week across the UK, Japan, Europe and Israel, with overflow support for the US. Managing interview scheduling in a fast-moving environment where priorities and availability can change. Maintaining reliable hiring records and clear handovers so candidates and colleagues know what to expect. Spotting recurring friction in a defined area of the process and helping address the root cause alongside day-to-day delivery. Using AI thoughtfully and exploring opportunities to improve hiring workflows through automation; boosting efficiency while keeping candidate experience and good judgement at the centre. 🙌 You should apply if: You bring experience from recruiting coordination or another detail-heavy, service-focused role, such as executive support, customer operations or events, and can show that you: Take ownership, prioritise competing requests and communicate early when something needs attention. Build trust through warm, clear and proactive communication with candidates and stakeholders. Stay accurate and calm when plans change, and take responsibility for your work. Learn new systems quickly, investigate problems and apply feedback. Are curious about improving processes and confident using AI tools thoughtfully in your work. Recruitment or ATS experience, including Ashby, would be useful, but it isn’t essential if you can demonstrate strong coordination, judgement and an ability to learn systems quickly. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working This role is based in our London hub, with a minimum of 2 days in the office. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Competency-based interview(s) focused on coordination, communication and judgement (45 mins) ecruiter screen (30 mins) Deep Dive interview with some of the team looking more closely at experience and team fit. (45 mins) Final interview (30 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Senior Integrated Operations Engineer
description: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. While other companies talk about it, we do it! ABOUT ENGINEERING AT ROCKET LAB: Engineering is at the heart of Rocket Lab . Our engineering team has a proven track record of designing and developing world-class rockets and spacecraft that are changing the way we access and use space . You'll work alongside driven , talented engineers from varied backgrounds and experience levels , all committed to the same mission . Our engineering team members span design , analysis , prototyping , testing , manufacturing , assembly and integration , quality control , engineering documentation , and more. About the Role As a Senior Engineer – Test and Launch Operations, you will provide hands-on technical leadership and project ownership within Rocket Lab's Test and Launch Operations team. You'll drive operational improvements, fill key on-console operations roles, and facilitate cross-team problem-solving to ensure our missions launch on time and with low risk. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact on the future of space access. What You'll Get to Do: Integrated Operations Identify and solve significant engineering challenges, independently or as part of a team Perform operator duties during test and launch campaigns, including development, qualification, and flight acceptance testing Facilitate inter-team problem solving to resolve issues impacting launch capability Uphold and contribute to engineering best practices in Test and Launch Operations Continuously improve and streamline testing and operational activities Identify and implement quality, efficiency, and cost improvements Optimize and automate checkout, processing, testing, and operations Take ownership of process improvement initiatives and drive common processes and tools across Integrated Operations Develop and implement solutions to support increasing operational cadence Technical Leadership Support development of resourcing plans and hiring strategies aligned with team objectives Set the standard for professionalism and skill in operator duties Use experience and sound judgment to make complex, risk-based decisions with limited information Process & Projects Lead and execute high-priority projects and systems for Test and Launch Operations Move with urgency, translating strategic priorities into action Take calculated risks to deliver solutions on time and within budget Challenge the status quo and seek creative solutions to tough problems Use metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement What You'll Bring: Essential Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronic Engineering, or equivalent 5+ years' experience in engineering, test, and/or operations Ability to read, understand, and follow detailed schematics, drawings, and instructions Self-driven, motivated, and contagiously positive attitude Excellent communication skills and ability to build strong working relationships Meticulous work ethic with a keen eye for detail Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines Comfortable working at heights and in confined spaces Desirable 8+ years' experience in engineering, test, and/or operations 2+ years' experience leading time-critical, multi-disciplinary engineering operations Experience with launch vehicles or spacecraft, including integration, testing, launch, and/or mission operations Experience with CAD systems Proficiency in Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming languages Experience with LabVIEW and PLC development for data acquisition & real-time control What Success Looks Like You deliver results—on time and within budget—by rallying support, challenging the status quo, and driving accountability through metrics. You're a role model for professionalism, positivity, and a "no job too tough" attitude. You coach and mentor junior engineers, elevate team standards, and consistently contribute to a culture of excellence. You communicate clearly and concisely, ensuring meetings and actions are purposeful and impactful. You proactively identify and solve problems, always striving for the best outcome for the business. Additional Information: Domestic and international travel may be required Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance Adherence to health and safety policies and procedures is required If the above sounds like you apply now! It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We’re an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.</p> <p>We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.</p> <p>Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer-Obsessed:</strong> We’re focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.</li> <li><strong>Make it Happen:</strong> We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Always Innovate:</strong> We push boundaries with creativity and technology.</li> <li><strong>Foster Belonging:</strong> We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.</li> </ul> <p>To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit <a href="http://www.gumgum.com/careers">www.gumgum.com/careers</a>.</p></div><p>Based in Manchester, the Digital Director, Regional UK is an autonomous individual contributor responsible for prospecting, negotiating, and closing advertising sales across the North of England. Reporting to the Regional Sales Lead and supported by a cross-functional pre-sales team, the role focuses on managing a large book of business, developing strategic relationships within large and mid-sized agencies, and upselling GumGum’s product portfolio. The Director leverages deep digital media expertise to independently solve complex client challenges, translate client feedback into internal product insights, and drive consistent regional revenue growth.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Achieve</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive regional UK revenue by managing a book of business and closing new business across large and mid-sized agencies in the North of England.</li> <li>Generate a high volume of prospecting activity, including cold outreach, pitch presentations, RFPs, and tailored sales solutions.</li> <li>Upsell existing brand and agency clients on both established and new GumGum advertising products.</li> <li>Cultivate and expand strategic relationships across client-direct brands, media agency contacts, and holding company teams.</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Client Strategists, and pre-sales teams to ensure sold proposals are executed accurately.</li> <li>Translate market and client insights back to internal product teams to help refine and adapt platform offerings.</li> <li>Exercise independent judgment and discretion to solve client challenges and select optimal ad solutions with minimal managerial oversight.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of digital advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing a large book of business, backed by an established network of regional brand and agency contacts.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the digital media and advertising landscape; programmatic background preferred.</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce for activity tracking, client logging, and pipeline reporting.</li> <li>Working proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.</li> <li>Strong presentation, relationship-building, and interpersonal communication skills across all client hierarchy levels.</li> <li>Self-motivated, highly proactive, and extraverted approach with an eagerness to entertain clients and adapt to evolving strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Learn about our benefits & perks package at <a href="https://gumgum.com/benefits">gumgum.com/benefits</a>. title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.</p> <h3>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</h3> <ul> <li>Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.</li> <li>Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.</li> <li>Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.</li> <li>Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.</li> <li>Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.</li> <li>Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.</li> <li>Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.</li> <li>Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.</li> <li>Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <ul> <li>Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.</li> <li>A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.</li> <li>Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.</li> <li>Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scope and influence.</strong> Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.</li> <li><strong>Real problems at global scale.</strong> Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy and ownership.</strong> Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.</li> <li><strong>Growth.</strong> Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.</li> <li><strong>Great people.</strong> Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.</li> </ul> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. title: Implementation Manager

title: Pricing Data Scientist
description: We started building Marshmallow in 2017. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. London (hybrid, 3 days in office) Pricing at Marshmallow This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new? We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency. We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements. We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors. All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with! What you’ll be doing Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing. Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers. Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python. Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python. Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing. Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value. Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals. Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products. Who are you? Proactive : You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities Modeller : You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class models Commercial : You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impact Curious : You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate further Owner : You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your area Opinionated : You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest way Explainer : You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-experts Networker : You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business What skills are we looking for from you? Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R Experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role (quant, credit, fraud etc) Perks of the job Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.
